newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cognex estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cognex estimates cut.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co said Friday it cut its earnings estimates for Cognex Corp based on the research firm's outlook for the semiconductor and electronics equipment sector.
--Analyst Mark Langley said he reduced his fourth quarter estimate to $0.15 a share from $0.21, and in turn the estimate for the full 1996 to $0.77 from $0.83.
--Langley said Gruntal's estimate for 1997 was also cut to $0.78 a share from $1.05.
--"We believe that the company has seen the bottom of this cycle, and recommend purchase for risk-oriented accounts with a long-term orientation," Langley said in a statement.
